signals.usability_note: A large white pine in the foreground blocks most of the house; only fragments of a white single-story structure are visible behind the tree, so the frontage cannot be assessed reliably.
signals.notes: The house is almost entirely hidden by a mature pine with low branches; two dark sedans are parked in the driveway on the right, and the lawn appears green with some patchy, shaded areas under the tree.
